system.description:
This functions in the next scene. You can identify enemies with an identification difficulty of 14 or less as [Identified] and know their abilities. As a cost, you will receive [Fatigue: [STR Base Value] + 10].

For sub-classes like Star Reader and Fortune Teller, the identification difficulty is not 14 or less, but 16 or less. This is a scroll that, when opened and concentrated upon, displays the form of the enemy you will likely encounter next. It reproduces the style of their attacks in full-color animation, allowing not only the discernment of their names and appearances but also their abilities.

Seven-Colored Dye [Core Material] (30G) + Glimpse Scroll (Beginner) (30G) + [Magic Catalyst 1] (15G) × 3 + Crafting Cost (45G)
